instruction: Studio portrait photograph, full shot, front view. In an indoor studio with a draped beige fabric backdrop, three generations of women pose together. In the background, the older woman with short dark hair (R1) sits behind R2, smiling at the camera. In the middle ground, the younger woman with medium-length brown hair (R2) sits with legs spread wide, smiling directly at the camera. In the foreground, the little girl with light brown hair (R3) sits between R2's legs, looking forward. R2 holds R3's hands in hers as R3 leans back against her. Soft, diffused studio lighting illuminates the scene in warm, neutral tones.
